pages.text: A new town has none of its crafting recipes unlocked — that greyed-out half of the list in the Item Workshop and the Equipment Workshop is exactly what those are. Nobody can craft a locked
recipe, and a shop cannot restock around one either: when goods run low the s$(br2)hop asks the Item Workshop, and a locked recipe leaves nothing to craft. Unlocks are per town and permanent.

Deposit an item into the warehouse and its own crafting recipe unlocks with it, so the quickest fix for a missing recipe is to put the item in. This route costs nothing but the item itself,$(br) which makes it the usual one early on.
pages.title: Deposit into the Warehouse

pages.text: A wild chest, or a tourist who leaves satisfied, may hand you an $(l:wandscape:items/blueprint_guide)Item Blueprint$(/l). Right-click a blueprint to open the recipe book, or click Recipes in the warehouse;
pages.title: Spend an Item Blueprint

pages.text: click Unlock on a row to spend one blueprint on that recipe. The blueprint does not ask you to own the item first, so save it for the recipes whose item you cannot get hold of.

Switch a wand to Identify mode and right-click a block to unlock that block's crafting recipe on the spot — no deposit and no blueprint needed. See $(l:wandscape:items/wand_guide)《Wand》$(/$(br)l) for the four modes and how to switch between them.
pages.title: Identify with a Wand
